title: 茶水间英文 - 10月24日 | 世界大赛首胜、AI断网训练、高司令复出
description:
The Brewers struck first in the World Series with a wild 3-2 Game One win, OpenAI pulled the plug on live internet for its smartest models, and Ryan Gosling is bringing his ghost band back just in time for Halloween. Alex and Jordan hand you the lines to steal for all three, plus a karaoke question with no backing out.

酿酒人队以一场惊险的 3 比 2 拿下世界大赛首战，OpenAI 给最先进的模型断了直播互联网，高司令则赶在万圣节前复活了自己的幽灵乐队。本期 Alex 和 Jordan 不光聊这三件事，还附送一个不许退缩的卡拉 OK 灵魂拷问。

Words to steal 生词本：
- struck first — 率先出手；拔得头筹
- nail biter — 扣人心弦的紧张比赛
- lock back in — 重新稳住；找回状态
- offline — 断网的；离线的
- guardrails — 安全护栏；防护措施
- comeback — 复出；回归
- backing out — 临阵退缩；打退堂鼓
